topicName: CI/CD Integration (GitHub Actions, Docker, Cloud Providers)
content:
[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"CI/CD Integration for Playwright with GitHub Actions, Docker, and Cloud Providers"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Automating your end-to-end testing workflow is essential for maintaining software quality. This tutorial guides you through setting up a robust CI/CD pipeline for Playwright using GitHub Actions, containerizing your tests with Docker, and scaling execution across cloud providers."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"1. Containerizing Playwright with Docker"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"Running Playwright inside a Docker container guarantees a consistent environment across local machines and CI/CD runners, preventing issues related to missing system dependencies or mismatched browser versions."},{"order":5,"type":"code","text":"FROM mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.40.0-jammy
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . . 
CMD ["npx", "playwright", "test"]"},{"order":6,"type":"subheading","text":"2. Setting up GitHub Actions Workflow"},{"order":7,"type":"paragraph","text":"Create a GitHub Actions workflow file in your repository under .github/workflows/playwright.yml. This workflow will trigger on pull requests and pushes to the main branch, executing your test suite automatically."},{"order":8,"type":"code","text":"name: Playwright Tests
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]
jobs:
  test:
    timeout-minutes: 60
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: 18
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm ci
    - name: Install Playwright Browsers
      run: npx playwright install --with-deps
    - name: Run Playwright tests
      run: npx playwright test
    - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      if: always()
      with:
        name: playwright-report
        path: playwright-report/
        retention-days: 30"},{"order":9,"type":"subheading","text":"3. Scaling with Cloud Providers"},{"order":10,"type":"paragraph","text":"For enterprise-scale applications, running tests sequentially on a single runner can become a bottleneck. You can scale your Playwright execution by leveraging cloud-based Selenium/CDP compatible providers or specialized cloud testing grids."},{"order":11,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Use Playwright's connectOverCDP method to connect to remote browser instances hosted on cloud infrastructure."},{"order":12,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Configure environment variables securely in GitHub Secrets for cloud provider authentication tokens."},{"order":13,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Shard your test suite across multiple parallel GitHub Action jobs using the --shard flag to drastically reduce overall pipeline execution time."},{"order":14,"type":"code","text":"npx playwright test --shard=1/3"},{"order":15,"type":"subheading","text":"Conclusion"},{"order":16,"type":"paragraph","text":"By combining GitHub Actions, Docker, and cloud scaling strategies, you achieve a reliable, fast, and scalable CI/CD pipeline for your Playwright test suite, ensuring high confidence in every deployment."}]
